title: Decision-Aware Memory Cards: Counterfactual-Inspired Context Selection and Compression for Tool-Using LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.08151v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) agents do not simply need longer contexts; they need decision-relevant evidence at the moment of action. We study decision-aware context selection: ranking retrieved files, tests, traces, rules, and memories by their expected effect on an agent's next action rather than by semantic similarity alone. We present the Counterfactual-Inspired Context Layer (CICL), which builds an instance context graph, estimates decision-oriented utility for candidate units, and compresses selected evidence into typed memory cards. The same schema can be instantiated with hosted LLM judges, local surrogates, or lightweight rankers, making the selection protocol auditable across model choices. On 50 SWE-bench Verified file-retrieval instances, Qwen3.6-Plus reranking of BM25 top-50 candidates improves hit@1 from 0.58 to 0.78 and MRR@10 from 0.634 to 0.790, with all 2,500 judgments parseable. translated_title: 决策感知记忆卡片：面向工具使用型大语言模型智能体的反事实启发式上下文选择与压缩
translated_abstract: 现代大语言模型（LLM）智能体不仅需要更长的上下文，更需要在与动作执行相关的时刻获得决策相关的证据。我们研究了决策感知的上下文选择问题：根据检索到的文件、测试、轨迹、规则和记忆对智能体下一个动作的预期影响进行排序，而不是仅仅依据语义相似度。我们提出了反事实启发式上下文层（CICL），它构建实例上下文图，估计候选单元的面向决策的效用，并将选定的证据压缩为类型化的记忆卡片。同一模式可以通过托管LLM评判器、本地代理模型或轻量级排序器来实例化，使选择协议在不同模型选择下均可审计。在50个SWE-bench Verified文件检索实例上，使用Qwen3.6-Plus对BM25 top-50候选进行重排序，将hit@1从0.58提升至0.78，MRR@10从0.634提升至0.790，且全部2,500个判断结果均可解析。受控诊断实验表明……
tldr: 本文提出反事实启发式上下文层（CICL），通过估计候选证据对智能体下一步行动的决策效用而非仅依赖语义相似度来选择并压缩上下文为类型化记忆卡片，在SWE-bench Verified文件检索任务上将hit@1从0.58显著提升至0.78。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Counterfactual-Inspired Context Layer (CICL), which selects and compresses context into typed memory cards by estimating the decision-oriented utility of candidate evidence for an agent's next action rather than relying on semantic similarity alone, improving hit@1 from 0.58 to 0.78 on SWE-bench Verified file retrieval.
